title: Tunnel linking Derinkuyu and Kaymakli
summary: Matt tells of Tunnel linking Derinkuyu and Kaymakli, about ancient, date unknown at Derinkuyu to Kaymakli, Turkey, and summarises it without a named source. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: there's a tunnel that goes from Darren kuyu all the way to kimley whoa 5 and a half miles underground

plain: A researcher called Matt, speaking with podcast host Jesse Michels, talks about Derinkuyu and Kaymakli, two ancient underground sites in Turkey. He says a tunnel runs between them for about five and a half miles underground. If so, it would show that whoever built them dug on a remarkable scale long ago.
